newsitem.title: UK: Tomkins up as Kleinwort repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: Tomkins up as Kleinwort repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in Tomkins Plc rose on Thursday as the group announced a 52 million stg disposal and analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson repeated a buy recommendation on the stock, dealers said.
Tomkins shares, which dropped earlier this week as the company killed hopes of a share buy-back with its first-half results, were up 6-1/2p at 274-1/2 by 1100 GMT in modest volume of 861,918.

Kleinwort analysts were not immediately available for comment. Earlier Tomkins said the sale of Ferraris Piston Service, an auto parts distributor, was in line with policy to sell parts of its business if in shareholders interest.
"Whilst we are sad to be selling such a fine company, this was clearly an offer that, being beneficial for shareholders, we could not refuse," said Tomkins executive chairman Greg Hutchings.
Tomkins said the sale valued the share capital of Ferraris at 52 million and that it would receive a further 9 million for the repayment of intercompany debt.
